For \(v=8\) singers and performances of size \(k=4\), let each pair perform together \(\lambda\) times.  
Each performance contains \(\binom{4}{2}=6\) pairs, and there are \(\binom{8}{2}=28\) pairs total, so
\[
6m=28\lambda \quad\Rightarrow\quad m=\frac{14\lambda}{3}.
\]
The smallest \(\lambda\) making \(m\) integral is \(\lambda=3\), giving
\[
m=\frac{14\cdot 3}{3}=14.
\]

Label the singers \(1,\dots,8\). Use the Fano plane lines on \(\{1,\dots,7\}\):
\[
123,\ 145,\ 167,\ 246,\ 257,\ 347,\ 356.
\]
A valid \(14\)-performance schedule is:
\[
\begin{aligned}
&8123,\ 8145,\ 8167,\ 8246,\ 8257,\ 8347,\ 8356,\\
&4567,\ 2367,\ 2345,\ 1357,\ 1346,\ 1256,\ 1247.
\end{aligned}
\]
Here each pair of singers appears together exactly \(3\) times.

\[
\boxed{14}
\]
